# telnyx_porting_uk_carriers (Data Source)

The UK carriers numbers can be ported from.

### Nested Schema for `porting_uk_carriers`

Read-Only:

- `alternative_cupids` (List of String) Alternative CUPIDs of the carrier.
- `created_at` (String) ISO 8601 formatted date indicating when the resource was created.
- `cupid` (String) The CUPID of the carrier. This is a 3 digit number code that identifies the carrier in the UK.
